feedTitle: Weather forecast for the Isle of Man

items.title: Weather forecast updated as of 28 May 2026 11:42am
items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Thursday, 28 May 2026 at 11:40am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

Staying dry but becoming cloudy later this afternoon with some hill fog and coastal mist, also the risk of fog patches in the south and east this evening. Top temperature around 20°C inland. Mostly moderate east to southeast winds gradually veering southerly, then freshening this evening.


##Outlook##

Dry tomorrow with spells of sunshine and moderate to fresh southwesterly winds. Top temperature 19°C.

Saturday will start dry and bright but soon turning cloudy ahead of a spell of rain developing in the afternoon, before clearing away later in the day. Light to moderate south or southwesterly winds will gradually increase through the day to become fresh to strong later. Top temperatures 16°C.
